terms.accuracy: أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي احتمالية ويمكن أن تنتج هلوسات. التحقق هو فلتر، لا وعد بالدقة. لا نضمن أن المخرجات خالية من الأخطاء أو كاملة. تحقّق بشكل مستقل من المعلومات الحرجة.
terms.advice: تقوم AssureProof بتحليل المستندات والتحقق منها وتجميعها. لا تقدّم مشورة قانونية أو مالية أو مهنية. استشر متخصصين مؤهلين قبل أن تتصرف بناءً على أي مخرج.
terms.answers: تعيد AssureProof صياغة سؤالك، ويمكن أن ترسله إلى نماذج تربطها، ويمكن أن تسقط ادعاءات لم تكن في ملفاتك. هذا فلتر، لا وعد بالدقة. أنت تفحص النتيجة قبل أن تستخدمها مع عميل، أو ورقة بحثية، أو قرار.
terms.as_is: يتم توفير البرنامج "كما هو"، دون ضمانات. نحن غير مسؤولين عن الأضرار أو العواقب الأخرى لاستخدامك. لا نضمن توفر النظام أو دقته أو ملاءمته لغرض معين. تُحدَّد مستويات الخدمة فقط في اتفاقيتك المؤسسية الموقَّعة.
terms.duty: أنت وحدك مسؤول عن كيفية استخدامك لأساس. توافق على عدم استخدامه لأي غرض غير قانوني، أو ضار، أو مسيء.
terms.files: ارفع فقط الملفات التي لديك الحق في استخدامها. لا ترفع ملفات مميزة، أو سرية، أو حساسة ما لم تكن مخولًا بذلك. لا ترسل نصًا صحيًا أو نصًا حساسًا آخر إلى مزوّد مفتوح على الإنترنت ما لم تقصد ذلك. نحن غير مسؤولين عن الرفع الذي يخالف التزاماتك الخاصة.
terms.indemnity: تغطي الخسائر التي تنشأ عن استخدامك لأساس. مسؤوليتنا الإجمالية مقيدة بالمبلغ الذي دفعته مقابل الخدمة. نحن غير مسؤولين عن الأضرار غير المباشرة، أو التبعية، أو التأديبية.
terms.law: أنت مسؤول عن كيفية استخدامك للمخرجات. إذا لم يكن من الممكن فرض هذه الشروط في موقعك، فإن الباقي لا يزال يُطبَّق.
terms.lead: كيف تعمل AssureProof، وما أنت مسؤول عنه، وما لا نعد به.
terms.prohibit: لا يجوز لك استخدام AssureProof لإنشاء أو الترويج لـ:
terms.providers: يجب عليك أيضًا الالتزام بشروط مزوّد الذكاء الاصطناعي الذي تربطه. الإرسال إلى مزوّد متصل يخضع لقواعد ذلك المزوّد. AssureProof لا تستبدلها.
terms.send: النسخ يبقي المطالبة المجمّعة داخل نشر الخاص بك. الإرسال يذهب فقط إلى المزوّد الذي اتصلت به. مغلق على الإنترنت يبقي السؤال في بيئتك. مفتوح على الإنترنت، يذهب إلى ذلك المزوّد. لا يحتفظ AssureProof بنص أسئلتك.
terms.third: نحن غير مسؤولين عن القرارات التي يتخذها أطراف ثالثة تعتمد على المخرجات. لا تشارك المخرجات مع آخرين دون التحقق الخاص بك.
terms.title: شروط الاستخدام
terms.use: أساس مصممة لتجميع المستندات والتحقق منها ومراجعة الامتثال. ليست بديلًا عن القرارات القانونية أو المالية أو التنظيمية الملزمة. إذا اعتمدت على المخرج كتحقق وحيد، فهذه المسؤولية تبقى عليك.
terms.verify: أنت وحدك مسؤول عن التحقق من المخرجات قبل أن تتخذ إجراءً. AssureProof هي مساعدة للحكم البشري، ليس بديلاً عنه. المراجعة البشرية إلزامية قبل أن تعتمد على أي مستند.

pipeline.1.name: Ingest Your File Stack
pipeline.1.line: Upload contracts, invoices, claims, or regulatory filings in any format. Every document stays isolated inside your environment.
pipeline.2.name: Page-Pinned Extraction (ParSure)
pipeline.2.line: Extracts every figure, obligation, and cross-reference—linking each data point directly to the exact page and line it came from.
pipeline.3.name: Structured Drafting (DraftSure)
pipeline.3.line: Generates reports, summaries, or approval memos built strictly from verified source facts, with zero ungrounded claims.
pipeline.4.name: Mathematical Consistency Check (Z3 Solver)
pipeline.4.line: Our formal logic engine tests whether every number and clause across all files can be true at the same time. If two facts conflict, export is automatically locked.
pipeline.5.name: Optional Adversarial Stress-Test (Red Hat Review)
pipeline.5.line: Trigger a separate, independent audit pass to hunt for edge-case ambiguities, missing attachments, or hidden compliance risks.
pipeline.6.name: Human Sign-Off & Audit Trail
pipeline.6.line: No document moves forward silently. An authorized reviewer resolves the conflict—or logs a formal override—before downloading the final file.

about.checks.1: AssureProof reads every document and keeps each figure tied to its source page. A language model then writes the draft. A formal consistency checker then tests whether the draft's figures and the values locked from the source can all be true at the same time. For a labeled figure, the language model does not make that call. For a sentence with no label, the language model turns it into a numeric comparison, and the formal consistency checker tests whether it holds. When a file is first read, the formal consistency checker can also flag figures in that file that contradict each other.
about.checks.2: Red-Hat review is separate, and it runs only when someone asks for it. A language model reads the draft the way a skeptical reviewer would and tries to find what is wrong: a mismatch with the attached source sentence, an overstatement, a missing clause, or a figure that needs a citation. It does not decide the numeric conflict. The review screen shows the contradiction and export is flagged. A person accepts or rejects each finding. The file can still be downloaded.
about.compare.row2.b: A formal consistency checker tests whether the draft's figure conflicts with the value locked from the source
about.compare.row3.b: The check marks the conflict, and both source pages stay attached
about.compare.row4.b: A language model writes the draft, then the formal consistency check runs on it. Red-Hat review, if someone runs it, tries to find what is wrong in that draft.
about.compare.row5.b: A person accepts or rejects each finding. The review screen shows the contradiction and export is flagged. The file can still be downloaded.
about.compare.row6.label: Where it runs
about.defining: AssureProof keeps the source page with every figure. A language model writes the draft from those files. A formal consistency checker tests whether the draft's figures and the locked source values can all be true at the same time. Red-Hat review is a separate language-model pass that tries to find what is wrong in that draft, and it runs only when someone asks for it. A person decides.
about.diff.1.text: AssureProof keeps the page, cell, or row for every figure, and every finding links back to it.
about.diff.2.name: The formal consistency checker tests the figures.
about.diff.2.text: A formal consistency checker tests whether the draft's figures conflict with the values locked from the source. The language model does not make that call for a labeled figure.
about.diff.4.text: The review screen shows the contradiction and export is flagged. A person accepts or rejects each finding. The file can still be downloaded. You choose where it runs: your AWS account or your own machines.
about.proof: The side-by-side example is the proof: a 142,500 EUR invoice is checked against a 120,000 EUR contract cap, both source pages stay open, the difference of 22,500 EUR is marked, and the mismatch is flagged before payment.
about.what.body: AssureProof checks one document against another. Both source pages stay open while the check runs, and the contradiction is shown on the review screen before you pay. Export is flagged while a conflict is unresolved, and a person decides whether the figure is right. The check runs inside your environment. Nothing is approved automatically.
about.who.1: Finance: supplier invoices checked against contract caps and agreed terms before the payment run, with the contract page open next to the invoice.
about.who.2: Claims: claim files checked against policies and the supporting documents that back each figure, before the payout.
about.who.3: Procurement: tenders and supplier packs checked against requirements and the documents behind each bid.
arch.flow.1.text: AssureProof reads both documents side by side and keeps the page, cell, or row for every figure it extracts, so the source stays reachable.
arch.flow.2.text: Figures are compared one to one. Where two labeled numbers cannot both be true at the same time, the conflict is marked on the review screen.
arch.where.body: Runs in your own AWS account, on-premises, or private GPU environment. You choose where the models run, and nothing is shared with other tenants. When the model is local, documents stay inside that boundary at every step of the check.

pricing.lead: Enterprise deployment, priced per team and per workflow. Custom to your document set.
pricing.price: Custom pricing, per team and per workflow.
pricing.pro.1: Runs in your own AWS account, on-premises, or private GPU environment, inside a boundary you control. Nothing runs on shared infrastructure, and nothing leaves it without your say-so.
pricing.pro.2: You choose where the models run: local, documents stay inside your environment; hosted, customer data is never used for training on your documents.
pricing.pro.3: Source pages stay linked: every figure keeps the page, cell, or row it came from, so anyone on the team can review the check without hunting for the original document.
pricing.pro.4: Export is flagged while a contradiction is unresolved. A person decides. The file can still be downloaded, with the flag recorded.
pricing.selective: 1 workflow. Limited sample cases. A written “Yes, proceed” is required. The assessment runs on your documents, in your environment, with a fixed scope agreed up front and a written review at the end.
sec.1.body: In your own AWS account, on-premises, or private GPU environment. You choose where the models run, and the deployment stays inside your network boundary. Nothing is shared with other tenants, and the infrastructure stays under your control.
sec.1.title: Where it runs
sec.2.body: Local: documents stay inside your environment, and nothing leaves it. Hosted: customer data is never used for training. With a local model, documents do not leave your boundary at any point in the check.
sec.2.title: Model boundary
sec.4.body: Every user signs in. Each project is visible only to its owner and the people they add. Access can be reviewed and revoked by your own administrators at any time.
sec.sub: Where AssureProof runs, what it stores and who can see it. Four sections, no fine print.

security.title: Zero data leakage. Built for sovereign and air-gapped environments.
security.sub: Your most sensitive contracts, claims, and regulatory filings never have to touch a third-party cloud. AssureProof deploys directly inside your perimeter so your security team retains 100% custody of both documents and models.
security.pillar1.title: Self-Hosted & Air-Gapped Ready
security.pillar1.desc: Deploy inside your own AWS VPC, private GPU cluster, or on-premises data center. When running local models, zero bytes ever leave your network boundary.
security.pillar2.title: Zero Model Training or Retention
security.pillar2.desc: Your documents are never logged, pooled, or used to train external foundation models. Every session executes in an isolated environment under your existing IAM and encryption keys (BYOK).
security.pillar3.title: Immutable Governance & Audit Logs
security.pillar3.desc: Every extracted figure, flagged contradiction, reviewer sign-off, and manual override is cryptographically timestamped—giving internal auditors and regulators a complete chain of custody.
landing.pilot.privacy: No file upload required today • Mutual NDA provided prior to sharing sample documents • Zero data retention
